name: playertrace
description: Engine-agnostic, privacy-conscious C++17 telemetry SDK for game developers.
$comment-dependencies: PlayerTrace vendors SQLite, nlohmann/json and Catch2 under third_party/, so the default build needs no vcpkg packages at all. Only the optional system-json feature pulls anything in.

system-json.description: Build against a vcpkg/system nlohmann-json instead of the vendored single header. Configure with -DPLAYERTRACE_USE_SYSTEM_JSON=ON. Catch2 is always vendored and is intentionally not offered here.

$comment-baseline: builtin-baseline is intentionally absent: it must name a real, tested vcpkg commit, and none has been pinned for this release. Add one (vcpkg x-update-baseline) before using the system-json feature from a manifest build; it is not required for the default vendored build.
